embed.title: !nest
embed.description: Alerts for pokemon nests: parks where one species spawns repeatedly until the next nest rotation.

fields.name: By pokemon
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}nest charmander`
`{{prefix}}nest dratini larvitar beldum d:3000`
`{{prefix}}nest vulpix form:alola` — one form only
`{{prefix}}nest everything` — any nest (a lot of alerts)

fields.name: Narrow by generation or type
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}nest everything gen1` — gen 1 species only
`{{prefix}}nest everything fire` — fire types only
`{{prefix}}nest bulbasaur charmander fire` — keeps only the named pokemon that are fire type
A type or `gen` on its own, without pokemon or `everything`, is not enough.

fields.name: Minimum spawn rate
fields.value: `minspawn:10` — only nests averaging 10 or more spawns an hour

fields.name: Where
fields.value:
With neither `d:` nor `area:`, your `{{prefix}}area` list is used (unless your admin set a default distance).
`d:3000` — within that many metres of your location
`location:home d:3000` — measured from a saved location (`{{prefix}}help location`)
`area:region_north` — only these areas instead of your list; several: `area:north,south`. Can't be combined with `d:`

fields.name: Options
Remove
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}nest remove charmander`
`{{prefix}}nest remove everything`
`{{prefix}}nest remove id:12` — one rule; `{{prefix}}tracked` shows the ids
